payload.summary: Codex reviewed the Pages deploy across three rounds. Round one found three real defects in scripts/deploy-pages.sh: it only detected a local gh-pages ref so a fresh clone would take the orphan path and be rejected non-fast-forward; cleanup ran only on success, leaving a registered worktree that blocks the next run; and the README claimed main-only while the script built whatever was checked out. Fixing the trap surfaced a fourth bug the review could not see: macOS mktemp returns /var/... while git records /private/var/..., so the first trap string-matched nothing and cleaned up nothing — caught by exercising a failing push against a scratch clone. Round two asked for the DEPLOY_FROM override to be documented, round three APPROVE (run ydpz7kgt).
